engine.provenance: self-built multi-architecture HIP engine; not an official release asset
engine.build_source_tree: engine sources (src/, include/, metal/, sycl/, CMakeLists.txt) clean at build time; the checkout is branch development, which carries the PR 4883 setup change as 9746cece and the PR 5562 fix as 588b9d34

build_json.note: BUILD.json records source=prebuilt because the locally built zip was installed with --prebuilt; the zip itself was built locally, which is why results.json build_kind=source is correct

engine_fix.pr_title: [Engine] prefill: the fused layout's shrink asks every layer's path, not only the formats
engine_fix.role: without it, STRATA_PF_FUSED=1 on this pack aborts with "the fused layout's MoE buffers are too small for layer 13's expert path"; every number here was measured with the fix present, so the reported configuration depends on an open engine pull request

strata_setup.pr_title: [Other] Setup: --gpus on Windows AMD: RDNA 2, 3 and 4 cards sharing one model
strata_setup.role: lets setup accept a --gpus split across AMD families and accept a self-built multi-arch engine; it changes no inference code

why_no_official_engine: Official release v0.2.12 ships per-family Windows HIP engines only (strata-engine-0.1.58-windows-x86_64-hip-rdna2.tar.gz, -rdna3; plus -rx6000/-rx9070/-halo for Linux). No official Windows HIP asset carries code for both gfx1030 and gfx1201, so a 6800 XT + R9700 split cannot run on any single official engine download. A self-built multi-arch engine is the documented path.
